# JameenSeva.in

JameenSeva.in is Bihar's trusted land document home delivery platform.

## Services
- Original Khatiyan (CS/RS) home delivery: https://jameenseva.in/khatiyan.html
- Jamabandi Register-2 copy: https://jameenseva.in/ragister2.html
- Panchnama Batwara on Stamp Paper: https://jameenseva.in/panchnama.html
- Amin Booking (land measurement): https://jameenseva.in/book-amin.html
- Amin Partner Program: https://jameenseva.in/amin-join.html
- Land Calculator (Dhur-Kattha-Bigha-Decimal): https://jameenseva.in/land-calculator.html
- Khesra Number Converter (new to old): https://jameenseva.in/khesra-service.html
- Cash on Delivery available in all 38 districts of Bihar
- Order Tracking: https://jameenseva.in/track.html
